nodes.label: Bun Native APIs
nodes.rationale: Prefer Bun-native server, database, file, process, and WebSocket APIs over Node ecosystem substitutes.

nodes.label: Privacy-preserving Clipboard Model
nodes.rationale: Clipboard codes and content are excluded from logs and aggregate analytics.

nodes.label: Release Policy
nodes.rationale: A release must start from clean main, use the release command, and finish only after Linux and Windows assets are publicly verified.

nodes.label: Cross-platform Release Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Linux assets are built locally while the release tag triggers cached Windows builds in GitHub Actions.
